final: WITH customer_averages AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.Country, AVG(i.Total) AS customer_avg FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.Country), country_averages AS (SELECT Country, AVG(customer_avg) AS country_avg FROM customer_averages GROUP BY Country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS overall_avg FROM country_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.country_avg), AVG(ca.country_avg - oa.overall_avg) FROM country_averages AS ca JOIN overall_average AS oa ON oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE ca.country_avg > oa.overall_avg
